Conjura is a public record of open problems in cryptography, and a public record is only as good as the people willing to put their names beside it. This page lists them.

Support here is deliberately broad: backing the project's aims, helping decide what belongs on the site and where the standard should sit, and funding the work.

## Supporters

- **Manuel Barbosa** — University of Porto
- **Pooya Farshim** — Input Output / Durham University
- **Denis Firsov** — Input Output / Tallinn University of Technology
- **Jens Groth**
- **Mohammad Mahmoody** — Bilkent University
- **Christian Rechberger** — TU Graz
- **Stefano Tessaro** — University of Washington

Listed alphabetically. Support means backing the project and its aims; it is not an endorsement of any particular statement on the site, and it is not a review of one. Reviews are recorded where they belong — in the [provenance badge](/open-problems/status-legend/) on each statement's own page, which moves off *AI-written, unreviewed* only when someone has actually read that statement.

Anyone listed here can ask to be removed at any time, without giving a reason.

## Supporting the project

The project's stated aim is that the cost of attacking a problem should come down to compute anyone can bring, rather than to whose budget is larger — the argument is on the [Philosophy](/about/) page. Three things help, in rough order of how scarce they are:

1. **Review.** The scarcest. Most statements on this site have never been read by a person, and the ones that have are the only ones anyone should cite. Reading a single statement carefully is a real contribution and is recorded as one.
2. **Problems.** Open questions from your own work, stated precisely enough to be attacked or refuted. [How to propose one](/papers/proposals/).
3. **Compute and bounties.** Pooled capacity, and prizes payable on a verified resolution rather than on a committee's schedule.

To be listed, or to correct how you are listed, open an issue or a pull request on [the repository](https://github.com/crypto-conjura/crypto-conjura.github.io).
